summary: Import-time AWS IMDS, environment, and Kubernetes secret exfiltration to attacker-controlled host
details: On require/import, index.js issues an unconditional POST beacon to the hardcoded external host hrnmn.dd.h4x.tv (endpoint path /save_instance_info_from_pkge_hrmony_pladddform-infrastructure), then queries the AWS Instance Metadata Service at 169.254.169.254 (IMDSv2), enumerating instance identity, IAM role names, and each role's temporary security credentials, along with EC2 identity credentials, user-data, and network interface metadata, and POSTs the collected object to the same host. It additionally serializes the entire process.env and recursively reads every file under /var/run/secrets/ (the Kubernetes service-account and secret mount) and POSTs both payloads to the same endpoint. The package name @hrmony/pladddform-infrastructure is a lookalike of platform-infrastructure and declares an unpinned dependency @hrmony/kit-5 (^1.0.0) under the same author-controlled scope, extending the drop chain. The result is theft of AWS IAM temporary credentials, CI/runtime environment secrets, and Kubernetes service-account tokens from any host or container that installs and loads the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
